state_machine.transition: If Start AND RetractDone, enter EXTEND; otherwise hold IDLE.
If ExtendDone, enter CLAMP; otherwise hold EXTEND.
If ClampDone, enter RELEASE; otherwise hold CLAMP.
If ReleaseDone, enter RETRACT; otherwise hold RELEASE.
If RetractDone, enter DONE; otherwise hold RETRACT.
Hold DONE until Stop or Reset.

timer_plan.note: No timers or timeouts; missing feedback stalls the active state.

priorities: Stop OR Reset overrides every normal transition and sets IDLE with all outputs FALSE in the same invocation.
Otherwise, evaluate only the transition associated with the pre-scan state; permit at most one transition per invocation.
All inputs are level-sensitive. After Stop or Reset clears, a still-asserted Start may initiate a new cycle if RetractDone is TRUE.
These software commands do not constitute a certified mechanical safety function.

initial_values.note: These are pre-invocation values; scan 0 executes normally.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample all inputs once and retain the pre-scan state for this invocation. No edge detectors are required; use sampled levels.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority & state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: If sampled Stop OR Reset is TRUE, set state to IDLE. Otherwise evaluate one CASE branch using the pre-scan state and update state at most once.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FBs are required, so this stage has no calls.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign Extend, Clamp, Release and Retract from equality of the updated state to their respective states; assign Busy as their OR and Done as state = DONE. These are the outputs observed at the end of the same scan.
